notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just a quick patch for some bugs that popped up

- Fixed an issue where Shanubis didn't spawn if the player didn't grab the spear right away
- Fixed an issue where the "Examine" action wasn't displaying text when interacting with a breakable wall

Cheers

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
A few quality-of-life changes and a bug fix.

- Herb drop fx are now white, and all drop fx colors have been brightened for better visibility.
- Gems now make a sound when they hit the floor.
- You should no longer get stuck when crouching off a ledge.

That's it, glhf.
